records.eligibility_summary: Entering freshmen with a 21 ACT composite (or concordant SAT) on a national/state test date or a final cumulative 3.0 GPA.
records.award_amount_text: Up to $2,250 per semester (freshman/sophomore) and $2,850 per semester (junior/senior) at four-year institutions; up to $1,600 per semester at two-year institutions.
records.application_method: Complete the 2027-2028 FAFSA (before April 1, 2027 for maximum state aid).
records.notes: From THEC's Class of 2027 senior guide (published July 2026), which instructs seniors to complete the 2027-2028 FAFSA before April 1, 2027; figures are those printed for that cohort and may change before the aid year begins.
